NONE: › to throw something so that it goes high in the air in a curve

› a high, curving hit of a ball
高球；挑高球
› (in some sports) to hit, kick, or throw the ball high in the air so that it goes over the head of your opponent
（體育比賽中）挑高球

example: Police started lobbing (= throwing) tear gas canisters into the crowd.
警察開始向人群投擲催淚彈。
The goalkeeper had come out of the goal and Webster lobbed the ball over his head into the empty net.
守門員離開了球門區，韋伯把球挑過守門員頭頂，射入了球門。
Jones hit a beautiful lob over his opponent's head.
瓊斯一記漂亮的挑高球，球從對手的頭頂上飛了過去。

遊說，試圖說服（政客、政府或官方團體）

C: › a group of people who try to persuade the government or an official group to do something
B2 the (large) room into which the main entrance door opens in a hotel or other large building

example: Small businesses have lobbied hard for/against changes in the tax laws.

他們一直在遊說國會修改涉槍法律。
the anti-smoking lobby
